definitions.gloss: bathroom; bathing area (the wet room with the tub)
definitions.explanation: The room in a Japanese house where one washes and bathes — containing the bathtub and a tiled washing area. Distinct from the toilet, which is a separate room.

examples.japanese: {風呂場|ふろば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{風呂場|ふろば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: The bathroom floor is slippery, so be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{風呂場|ふろば}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧にあった。
examples.english: It was an old apartment, so the bath and the toilet were in the same room.

notes:
⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧ (bath) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place). Refers specifically to the wet area where one bathes — in a typical Japanese home this is a separate room from the toilet (⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧) and from the dressing area (⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風呂場|ふろば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean the bathroom
- {風呂場|ふろば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排水口|はいすいこう}→排水口：16250_haisuikou⟧: bathroom drain
- {風呂場|ふろば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転|ころ}ぶ→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧: to slip in the bathroom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧: the bath (the act or the tub itself)
- ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧: bathroom — more formal, used in real estate and instructions
- ⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧: changing area just outside the bath
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧: toilet — a separate room in most Japanese homes
